text:
rita: Quick thread for Night Pulse — small, focused asks: unify token names, pick a chart hue family, and fix comment color in syntax. Screenshot attached.
omar: For charts, single-hue ramp (deep purple -> soft violet) reads better across dashboards than multi-hue. Keeps magnitude intuitive.
maria: Agree on single-hue. Also we should stop using `--accent` as a literal; use `--interactive`/`--danger`/`--info`. Leaves room for semantic swaps.
rita: Proposed CSS snippet: ```:root { --bg-900: #090912; --panel-800: #0f1016; --interactive: #b783ff; --code-bg: #0b0c10; --comment: #6f7280 }```
sam: Accessibility: contrast-bot flagged `--comment` at #6f7280 as 3.6:1 vs code-bg. Need >=4.5 for small text. Suggest #83858d or make comments italic + slightly bolder if we want lighter color.
contrast-bot: report: `night-pulse-syntax` comment token ratio 3.6:1 (FAIL). tooltip bg 0.92 alpha recommended for consistency.
omar: UX nit: the dark toggle label should be "Appearance: Dark" per previous thread. Also add a keyboard hint (press "A" to toggle) in the accessibility menu.
rita: Action items: (1) I'll update token naming and push mapping, (2) omar will generate a single-hue purple ramp and attach PNGs, (3) maria to run contrast checks and propose comment hex that passes AA, (4) sam to draft toggle copy. Any objections?
maria: No objections. I'll post the contrast matrix by EOD.
sam: I'll write the tiny copy PR and include keyboard shortcut suggestion.
rita: Thanks all 680 — will follow up with the mapping PR and images.
